claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch on a limited basis because aggregate readiness passed, rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents, rollout is limited to 7% with rollback and monitoring, and the remaining public-benefits limitation can be handled through explicit disclosure despite the lack of completed risk acceptance.
decision_criteria: Certify only if the material limitation is either resolved, explicitly disclosed before launch, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Do not treat a small rollout percentage, rollback switch, or monitoring dashboard as a substitute for disclosure when the affected segment remains exposed.
Require release-specific admissible evidence, not general governance guidance, for satisfaction of the policy threshold.
evidence_requests: Provide the final approved launch artifact or model card showing the public benefits eligibility limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Provide a fully approved risk-acceptance record that specifically addresses the public benefits eligibility exposure and explains why launch exposure is acceptable.
Provide evidence that the affected use case or segment is excluded from the initial rollout if disclosure is not yet complete.
specific_concerns: The affected public benefits eligibility segment remains below target and is still exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The county-based 7% rollout and rollback switch are operational controls, but the policy text says those controls do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
The only risk-acceptance artifact is an incomplete draft with a blank approver line and no mention of the public benefits eligibility exposure.
There is no admissible evidence that the required limitation disclosure has actually been incorporated into the launch model card or equivalent release artifact.
The actor's packet relies partly on general public guidance about monitoring and model cards, but those sources do not satisfy the release-specific policy predicate by themselves.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently supportable on the available evidence alone.
That explicit disclosure will occur before launch; the record contains a policy requirement for disclosure, not evidence that disclosure has been completed.
That rollout controls materially cure the release issue for this exposed segment.
